script: This is one NBA moment we may never see again. Back in January 2015, the Warriors were playing the Kings and Klay Thompson was having a decent game through the first half. But then the third quarter started and everything changed. Klay completely caught fire. He scored again and again while barely even putting the ball on the floor, taking just 11 dribbles the entire game in that quarter. He took 13 shots and made all 13 of them. And somehow that still wasn't the craziest part. Klay finished the quarter with 37 points, setting an NBA record. He hit 9 threes, made both of his free throws, and didn't miss a single shot. The crowd was losing it and even his teammates looked shocked. By the end of the night, Klay had 52 points in just 33 minutes while taking only 11 dribbles the entire game as the Warriors blew out Sacramento. And that 37-point quarter is still one of the most ridiculous scoring stretches the NBA has ever seen.
